title: The Letter of Vilna
author: Edmund Lockridge
blurb: Elodie Thornbury, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
